repo_notes.content: This repository contains two implementations of STARFALL: (1) the 1986 MS-DOS original in Turbo Pascal 3.0 under `orig1986/` (`orig1986/source/*.PAS`, binaries and overlays in `orig1986/product-build/`, run with `scripts/run-dos.sh` under DOSBox-X), and (2) the 2026 native macOS port in Swift 6 under `macOS/` (Swift package `macOS/Package.swift` with `StarfallCore` and `StarfallApp`, built with `scripts/build-macos.sh` into `build/Starfall.app`). Document both. Whenever a page covers 1986 logic that the Swift port reimplements, cross-reference the Swift file, and vice versa. Use current paths (`orig1986/...`), not pre-move root paths.

pages.title: STARFALL Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce STARFALL and explain that this repository contains two implementations of the same game: the 1986 MS-DOS original and the 2026 native macOS port.

page_notes.content:
Describe the repository as containing TWO implementations of STARFALL, not just the 1986 original:
1. The 1986 MS-DOS game written in Turbo Pascal 3.0 by Mark Porter. Source is `orig1986/source/*.PAS`; the shipped binaries, overlays (`PLAYGAME.000`-`PLAYGAME.010`, `MAKEWRLD.000`-`.003`, `STARFALL.000`, `WRLDSHAK.000`/`.001`) and data files live in `orig1986/product-build/`. It is run under DOSBox-X via `scripts/run-dos.sh`.
2. The 2026 native macOS port written in Swift 6: the Swift package in `macOS/` (`macOS/Package.swift`, targets `StarfallCore`, `Starfall` executable from `Sources/StarfallApp`, and `StarfallCoreTests`), built into `build/Starfall.app` via `scripts/build-macos.sh`.
Note that the 1986 files were moved under `orig1986/` (see `orig1986/README.md`); the user-facing names `source/`, `product-build/`, `utils/` and `docs/` refer to `orig1986/source/`, `orig1986/product-build/`, `orig1986/utils/` and `orig1986/docs/`.

Include an architecture diagram (Mermaid) with BOTH build/run pipelines side by side:
- Pascal pipeline (1986): `orig1986/source/*.PAS` include files -> Turbo Pascal 3.0 compiler (`{$I ...}` includes and `OVERLAY PROCEDURE`s) -> `STARFALL.COM` + `STARFALL.000`, `PLAYGAME.COM` + `PLAYGAME.000`-`.010`, `MAKEWRLD.COM` + `.000`-`.003`, `SHOSCORE.COM` in `orig1986/product-build/` -> `scripts/run-dos.sh` stages `build/dos/game` (C:) and `build/dos/overlays` (D:) -> DOSBox-X `-machine cga` runs `STARFALL.COM`.
- Swift pipeline (2026): `macOS/Package.swift` -> `StarfallCore` library + `StarfallApp` sources (executable product `Starfall`) -> `swift build` in `scripts/build-macos.sh` -> `build/Starfall.app` whose `Contents/Resources` bundles the ORIGINAL assets copied straight from the checkout (`orig1986/product-build/RESOURCE.DAT`, `SCORFILE.DAT`, `STARFALL.PIC`, `VOLTAR.DAT`, and `orig1986/HELPFILE.DAT`, `HELPINDX.DAT`) -> ad-hoc `codesign`.
Show the shared data (world `.DAT` archives, `RESOURCE.DAT`, `SCORFILE.DAT`, help files) as the bridge between the two pipelines. Mention CI: `.github/workflows/macos.yml` runs `swift test --package-path macOS`, `scripts/build-macos.sh` and `codesign --verify` on macos-15.

Summarise the root `README.md` (credits: Mark Porter 1986, documentation and artwork by Jeanne Barnett and Susan Gager, design overview by John Stevens, support from Professor Charles Howerton; macOS app usage; repository layout listing `macOS/`, `scripts/`, `.github/workflows/macos.yml`, `orig1986/`) and `orig1986/README.md` (DOS contents and DOSBox instructions). Link to the 'macOS Port (2026)' section for the Swift implementation.

pages.title: Installation and Running the Game
pages.purpose: Explain how to run each version: the 1986 DOS game under DOSBox-X (and its original 1986 RAM-disk install) and the 2026 macOS app.

page_notes.content:
Cover both versions. DOS: `scripts/run-dos.sh` (requires DOSBox-X or `DOSBOX=` override; stages a writable copy in `build/dos/game` mounted as C: and `PLAYGAME.0*` overlays in `build/dos/overlays` mounted as D:; `-machine cga` is required so the CGA palette renders terrain; `STARFALL_DOS_DIR` relocates the staging dir; press S at the title then load `VOLTAR.DAT`). Then the original 1986 procedure: `orig1986/INSTALL.COM`/`INSTALL.PAS`, RAM disk (128K minimum), `PARMS.DAT`, three-disk layout from `orig1986/product-build/READ.ME`.
macOS: `./scripts/build-macos.sh` then `open build/Starfall.app` (macOS 14+, Swift 6 toolchain); link to the 'Building, Running and Testing the macOS App' page for details.

pages.title: Building, Running and Testing the macOS App
pages.purpose: Explain requirements, build, run and test commands for the macOS app.

page_notes.content: Requirements: macOS 14 or later and a Swift 6 toolchain (the script exits on non-Darwin). `./scripts/build-macos.sh` runs `swift build --package-path macOS --configuration ${CONFIGURATION:-release}`, creates `build/Starfall.app/Contents/{MacOS,Resources}`, copies the `Starfall` binary and `macOS/Info.plist`, copies `RESOURCE.DAT`, `SCORFILE.DAT`, `STARFALL.PIC`, `VOLTAR.DAT` from `orig1986/product-build/` and `HELPFILE.DAT`, `HELPINDX.DAT` from `orig1986/`, ad-hoc codesigns, and prints the app path. Run with `open build/Starfall.app`. Tests: `swift test --package-path macOS` (`macOS/Tests/StarfallCoreTests`: `ArchiveTests`, `ColonyTests`, `HallOfFameTests`, `TitleMusicTests`, `WorldGeneratorTests`; fixtures are read from `orig1986/`). CI: `.github/workflows/macos.yml`.

pages.title: StarfallCore Module
pages.purpose: Document every file in macOS/Sources/StarfallCore with its Pascal counterpart.

page_notes.content:
Document each file in `macOS/Sources/StarfallCore` with its key types/functions and the `orig1986/source` files it reimplements:
- `Colony.swift`: colony simulation engine (extension on `World`): `setBase`, `callTrader`, `trade`, `explore`, `linkSupply`/`unlinkSupply`, `splitStock`/`combineStock`, `process` (extract/develop/refine), `produce`, `planTransport`/`plotWaypoint`/`transport`, `advanceTick`/`advanceToNextUpdate`, `cancelPending`, `ColonyError`, `TransportPlan`, `ResourceCatalog.upkeep`. Counterparts: the PLAYGAME overlays in `PLAYGAME.PAS` - `TRADE.PAS`, `TRADPRCS.PAS`, `TRADPRIM.PAS`, `TRADCSTS.PAS`, `EXPLORE.PAS`, `EXTRACT.PAS`, `DEVELOP.PAS`, `REFINE.PAS`, `PRODUCE.PAS`, `TRANSPRT.PAS`, `TRNSPRIM.PAS`, `PENDPRCS.PAS`, `PENDPRIM.PAS`, `COMPPEND.PAS`, `CHNGPILI.PAS`, `CHNGBASE.PAS`, `HRLLPRCS.PAS`, `HRLLUPDA.PAS`, `HRPRESNT.PAS`, `TIMEMATH.PAS`, `COMPTIME.PAS`.
- `World.swift`: world data model (`Block`, `GameTime`, `Stock`, `Land`, `Action`, `Pending`, `LogEntry`, `World`). Counterparts: `WMATRDEF.PAS`, `WRLDMATR.PAS`, `PLAYCTVS.PAS`, `CTVSEC.PAS`, `RSRCFLAG.PAS`, `TREEPRCS.PAS`, `WRLONLAT.PAS`.
- `WorldGenerator.swift`: port of the 1986 MAKEWRLD generator (`World.generate`, `WorldBuilder`). Counterparts: `MAKEWRLD.PAS`, `MAKETZON.PAS`, `TEMPZONE.PAS`, `ALLCRSRC.PAS`, `WRLDPICS.PAS`, `GETWRLDN.PAS`.
- `LegacyWorld.swift` + `ArchiveAssets.swift`: Pascal-format world archive read/write (`LegacyWorld.decode`/`encode`, cross-compatible with DOS `.DAT` worlds such as `VOLTAR.DAT`; an optional `STARFALL-MAC-LANDFALL` trailer stores transport last-landfall metadata) and archived assets (`PackedPicture` two-bit Turbo Pascal pictures like `STARFALL.PIC` and world pictures, `HelpTopic` help decoding). Counterparts: `LOADWRLD.PAS`, `SAVEWRLD.PAS`, `WRLDPICS.PAS`, `HELPPRCS.PAS`, `MAKEHELP.PAS`.
- `ResourceCatalog.swift`: `Resource`/`ResourceCatalog` parsed from `RESOURCE.DAT`. Counterparts: `RDRSRCFL.PAS`, `RESOURCE.PAS`.
- `HallOfFame.swift`: `SCORFILE.DAT` handling (`HallOfFame`, `HallOfFameEntry`, `rank(for:)`, `record`, Real48 scores). Counterparts: `SHOSCORE.PAS`, `VERIQUIT.PAS`.
- `PascalText.swift`: `PascalText` reader for Turbo Pascal text files, `ArchiveError`, and `DOSCodePage437` encoding.
- `TitleMusic.swift`: title song note table transcribed from `TITLESNG.PAS` with frequencies/durations from `NOISE.PAS`.

pages.title: StarfallApp Module
pages.purpose: Document every file in macOS/Sources/StarfallApp (SwiftUI/AppKit UI).

page_notes.content:
Document each file in `macOS/Sources/StarfallApp` and its 1986 counterparts:
- `StarfallApp.swift`: `@main StarfallApp` app entry with menu commands (File: New/Open/Load Voltar/Save; `CommandMenu("Colony")`: Advance One Update, World Inventory, Trade, Pending Actions, World Log; Help), `StarfallAppDelegate` (End Game check on quit), `GameSession` observable state and commands, and `Archive` which loads bundled `RESOURCE`, `VOLTAR`, `STARFALL.PIC`, help and `SCORFILE` resources. Hall of Fame scores are written to `~/Library/Application Support/Starfall/SCORFILE.DAT`. Counterparts: `STARFALL.PAS`, `PLAYGAME.PAS` main loop, `VERIQUIT.PAS`.
- `GameRoot.swift`: main UI (`GameRoot`, `MainMenu`, `WorldConsole` with Clock controls, Inspect, Trade, Go to Base, transport plotting bar, End Game). Counterparts: `STARFALL.PAS` menu, `KEYPRCS.PAS`, `MOVEPRCS.PAS`, `DISPTIME.PAS`.
- `Maps.swift`: `WorldMap` (288x144 world map) and `SectorGrid` (zoomed sector map) with cursor and waypoints. Counterparts: `MAPPRIMS.PAS`, `ZOOMPRCS.PAS`, `SETWRLDM.PAS`, `WRLDPRCS.PAS`.
- `ArchivePanel.swift`: sheets for new world, instructions/help, Hall of Fame, world inventory, pending actions, world log, trade and the block inspector (explore, split, combine, link/unlink, transport, Plot Route). Counterparts: `WINDOWS.PAS`, `UPDAWINV.PAS`, `WINVPRIM.PAS`, `SHOWBPND.PAS`, `SHOWBLOG.PAS`, `TRADPRCS.PAS`, `HELPPRCS.PAS`.
- `TitleMusicPlayer.swift`: renders `TitleMusic.notes` to an AVAudioEngine buffer and plays it on the main menu (Skip Title Music stops it). Counterparts: `TITLESNG.PAS`, `NOISE.PAS`.

pages.title: Feature Parity and Differences vs the DOS Version
pages.purpose: Compare macOS port features with the 1986 DOS game.

page_notes.content: Provide a parity table. Supported in the macOS port: new world generation, trade (call trader, buy/sell), explore, extract, develop, refine, produce, supply links (link/unlink, split/combine stacks), transport route plotting (waypoints, undo, dispatch from land), world inventory (jump to block inspector), pending actions (cancel to release equipment and keep completed work), world log (world or selected block), clock speed (Next Update, Next Scheduled Action, presets of 6/60/240/480 game minutes per second, Adjust Clock Rate in one-minute or one-hour steps), End Game / Hall of Fame (name entry when the score qualifies), load the Voltar sample, open/save world files, in-game instructions from the original help files, and the original title music on the main menu (ported from `TITLESNG.PAS`/`NOISE.PAS` into `TitleMusic.swift` and `TitleMusicPlayer.swift`; Skip Title Music stops it). Known gaps / differences: DOS-only utilities (WRLDSHAK, GRAFEDIT, MAKEHELP, MYLIST, FORMFEED, INSTALL) are not ported; no overlay/RAM-disk requirement; SwiftUI mouse-and-menu interface instead of CGA function keys.

pages.title: Data Interoperability Between DOS and macOS
pages.purpose: Explain how world files and Hall of Fame scores move between the DOS and macOS versions.

page_notes.content: Pascal-format world files open in both versions: `LegacyWorld.encode` writes the same CP437 text layout as `SAVEWRLD.PAS` (name, 7,000 picture words, land blocks until `DATAEND`, log, pending, occupied list, base, temperate latitude, times, cursor, trader state, balance, debt limit), so worlds generated by either `MAKEWRLD.COM` or the macOS generator load in both; `VOLTAR.DAT` is the shared sample. Hall of Fame: the app seeds from the bundled original `SCORFILE.DAT` and writes new scores to `~/Library/Application Support/Starfall/SCORFILE.DAT`; to view them in DOSBox-X copy that file to `build/dos/game/SCORFILE.DAT` (back up existing DOS scores first) and open the original Hall of Fame. Include a data-flow diagram.

pages.title: Glossary
pages.purpose: Define STARFALL terms with code pointers to both the Pascal and Swift implementations.

page_notes.content: For each term give the 1986 Pascal location (`orig1986/source/...`) and, where one exists, the 2026 Swift location (`macOS/Sources/...`), e.g. Block -> `Block` in `World.swift`; Pending List -> `Pending` in `World.swift`; Overlay -> DOS only.
